title: RozgarSetu — Workforce Hiring Portal
shortDescription: A premium, bilingual (Hindi + English) workforce hiring ecosystem built in PHP — connecting verified Workers, Businesses, and Contractor Partners with KYC verification workflows, digital wallet systems, and a multi-tier user architecture inspired by Digital India.
overview: RozgarSetu (रोजगार सेतु) is a premium, mobile-first workforce hiring portal designed to bridge India's employment gap for blue-collar and semi-skilled workers. Inspired by the Digital India and Skill India initiatives, the platform connects three user groups: Workers/Job Seekers (श्रमिक), Businesses/Employers (व्यापार), and Contractor Partners (साझेदार). The platform features a rich bilingual UI in both English and Hindi Devanagari, making it accessible to diverse Indian demographics. Built with PHP 8 server-side rendering, Bootstrap 5 grid, and a custom Vanilla CSS design system, the portal showcases KYC verification workflows (Aadhaar, eShram, PAN), Partner digital wallet systems with commission tiers (Silver/Gold/Platinum), and comprehensive admin oversight. The current version is a fully designed UI/UX prototype with a detailed system architecture and database schema ready for backend implementation.
status: In Progress (Frontend Complete, Backend Architecture Designed)
features: Multi-role architecture — Workers, Businesses, Partners, and Admin
Bilingual UI — seamless Hindi Devanagari and English throughout
Mobile-first responsive design optimized for ~95% mobile user base
Worker KYC verification workflows — Aadhaar, eShram, PAN document visualizers
Partner digital wallet system with Silver/Gold/Platinum commission tiers
Partner bulk worker onboarding at ₹30 per registration (wallet deduction)
Direct worker self-registration at ₹50 one-time fee
Business KYC with GSTN and company document verification
Job posting system with admin approval before going live
Worker application tracking with status lifecycle management
Dynamic stat counters triggered on scroll into view
Active page navigation tracking using PHP backend routing
Reusable PHP template architecture (header, navbar, footer includes)
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages with full legal content
Fully designed database schema with ERD for MySQL backend

architecture.pattern: PHP Multi-Page with Reusable Template Includes
architecture.description: The project uses PHP 8 for server-side page rendering with a reusable includes system (header.php, navbar.php, footer.php) shared across all pages. Active page state is tracked using PHP's basename($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']) for automatic navigation highlighting. The system architecture document defines a complete MySQL database schema with 7 entity groups and full ERD relationships.

userRoles.capabilities: Full platform control — verify workers/businesses/partners, approve jobs, manage wallets, view reports
Register, complete profile, upload KYC, add skills/education, apply for jobs, track applications
Register company, upload KYC, post jobs, view applications, coordinate hiring
Register workers in bulk, manage digital wallet, track commission tiers, view worker list

myRole: Sole Developer and Architect. Designed the complete frontend, PHP architecture, reusable template system, and the full system architecture document including database schema, workflow diagrams, and future backend roadmap.
challenges: Designing a multi-role platform with three distinct user journeys (Worker, Business, Partner) and a shared admin layer — each with different dashboards, KYC requirements, and workflows
Building a bilingual UI that seamlessly mixes Hindi Devanagari and English text without breaking layout or causing font rendering issues
Architecting a Partner digital wallet system with tiered commission structures and real-time balance deductions that maintains data integrity across concurrent transactions
Representing complex business logic (KYC workflows, job approval flows, hiring pipeline) as visual UI mockups that feel authentic to end users
Designing a mobile-first layout for users on low-end devices common in the target demographic
solutions: Created separate dedicated PHP pages (worker.php, business.php, partner.php) with page-specific content while sharing a common header, navbar, and footer via PHP includes — maintaining clear separation of user journeys
Used Google Fonts with extended character sets (Poppins supports Devanagari) and established CSS font-family fallbacks for cross-platform text rendering
Designed the wallet system with a WALLET-TRANSACTIONS audit table and double-entry balance tracking pattern in the MySQL schema, ensuring every debit is logged before the worker account is created
Built detailed UI mockups showing mock KYC document upload states, mock transaction ledgers, and tier commission tables to accurately represent the planned backend functionality
Applied Bootstrap 5's mobile-first breakpoint system for grid layout and custom CSS for large touch targets (minimum 44px), sticky navigation, and optimized typography scaling
keyLearnings: Designing complex multi-role platform architectures with distinct user journeys and shared admin oversight
PHP reusable template architecture using server-side includes for consistent multi-page websites
Bilingual web design — integrating Hindi Devanagari text with English in a cohesive responsive layout
MySQL relational database schema design for a workforce management system with ERD relationships
Building detailed system architecture documents that bridge UI/UX design to backend implementation planning
